body.estimand_functional: \(\tau_n(z_0)=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{\mathbb E_P[\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0,E_0]-m_s(z_{0s})\}\), identified conditional on event transport and estimated by the raw \(\widehat\tau\). Sharp conditional MSE and honest expected-length guarantees hold over \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\) at \(R_{\star,\beta}\) and \(R_{\star,\beta}^{1/2}\), respectively. The donor channel is conditional on the two-sided local modulus; the iid term \(T^{-2\lambda/d}\) is only a stricter-design comparator.

sampling_model.design: Conditional on the event state \(E_0\), each cohort has \(T\) exactly observed pre-event proxy paths with one-time densities bounded above and away from zero and a geometrically beta-mixing calendar process. These assumptions allow rare local-state blocks, which generate the sharp log-adjusted spacing term.
sampling_model.units: At each historical path, cohort \(s\) supplies \(n_s\) bounded replicated untreated wealth blocks. The sharp risk and interval results use two explicit strong restrictions: historical errors are centered given the complete design, and event means are stable given that design. Neither restriction follows from contemporaneous regression centering or conditional cross-unit independence.
sampling_model.treatment: The event occurs at \(t=0\). Consistency, limited anticipation, no spillovers, and the maintained cross-date cohort-average event-transport equality identify the untreated finite-cohort event mean from the historical path regression.
sampling_model.overlap: The realized event path lies in an interior positive-probability region and every one-time historical design density is bounded below there. No sequential-overlap or other anti-clustering assumption is added.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: An independent conditional donor sample estimates only the event query and its unknown full covariance. The local-polynomial selector begins at the log-adjusted scale and tests normalized Gram shape. The interval uses the full-data raw estimator, exact bounded unit-history and event Hoeffding radii, the exact Taylor allowance, and a fourth-moment full-covariance donor radius.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The paper derives identification and asymptotic-bias conditions for financial event-study estimators and explains that buy-and-hold comparisons require volatility matching.
The Holder repeated-measurement prediction rate has sparse order \((nm)^{-2s/(2s+d)}\) and dense order \(n^{-1}\), up to the stated logarithmic qualifications.
A local-polynomial Lepski procedure adapts pointwise to local design mass and local Holder smoothness under observed random design.
Theorem 1 expands local-linear regression with a generated covariate attached to every training observation through smoothed first-stage errors.
Theorems 3.1--3.6 establish deconvolution rates when latent training coordinates have replicated classical measurement error.
Theorems 7--8 evaluate a rate-optimal local-polynomial regression estimator at a sample-split estimated strongly convex minimizer.
The dependent-data theorem uses large-block--small-block coupling for conditional approximation of synthetic-control prediction error.
Spline and wavelet series estimators attain optimal uniform rates and functional normality under beta mixing and weak moments.
Ordered moduli characterize optimal confidence procedures for linear functionals over convex regression classes in a fixed Gaussian experiment.
The many-period--many-control result gives conditions for synthetic-control factor-loading recovery under imperfect pre-treatment fit.
The proximal synthetic-control theorems identify treatment effects by using excluded control outcomes as predetermined proxies.

body.tldr: The target is the cohort-weighted finite-cohort causal buy-and-hold level-wealth effect at a realized event path. Maintained cohort-average event transport identifies it through historical wealth-path regression, and the raw generated-center local-polynomial estimator is exactly a weighted panel event coefficient. Sharp conditional MSE and honest expected length are established on the explicitly full-design-centered subclass. Under geometric beta mixing and marginal density alone, the sharp calendar-spacing scale is log-adjusted: rare blocks make the logarithm unavoidable. A normalized-shape selector, exact historical and event Hoeffding radii, an observable Holder allowance, and a full-covariance donor allowance attain the frontier without sequential overlap, deconvolution, studentization, or a dense-local-site condition.

project_justification.gap: Existing repeated-measurement, generated-regressor, and synthetic-control results do not jointly distinguish causal transport, full-design replication, an externally generated event center, and the local-spacing cost allowed by geometric mixing. In particular, one-time design density plus geometric beta mixing does not imply iid-quality pointwise spacing.
project_justification.niche: The panel observes historical proxy paths exactly, replicates bounded wealth blocks across units, and generates only the event-date query from an independent donor universe. This separates treated noise, response replication, calendar resolution, and donor uncertainty in one causal experiment.
project_justification.fill: The note proves the identifying functional and exact FWL representation, embeds all four lower-bound channels in full-design-centered causal panels, derives the same-class log-adjusted risk frontier, and constructs a full-data bias-aware conditionally honest interval attaining the matching expected-length frontier in every relative-growth regime.

body.related_work: Goldsmith-Pinkham and Lyu motivate the causal financial-panel and volatility-drag layers but do not replace the maintained event-transport restriction. Yan, Yao, and Zhou study repeated-measurement prediction; Gaiffas studies pointwise random-design smoothing; Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle study generated coordinates attached to training observations; and Delaigle, Hall, and Meister study replicated classical measurement error. Cattaneo, Feng, and Titiunik motivate dependent-data coupling, but geometric beta mixing alone does not exclude the rare-state clustering proved here. Armstrong and Kolesar motivate modulus-based honest-length comparisons. The present contribution is the positive-probability joint causal-panel embedding, exact FWL identity, higher-smoothness donor saturation, and the all-relative-regime log-adjusted frontier on a transparent full-design-centered class.
body.technical_internal_limitation: Causal identification remains conditional on cohort-average event transport. Sharp risk and honest expected-length results are explicitly restricted to the subclass with event full-design mean stability and historical full-design centering. The donor lower channel remains conditional on the assumed two-sided local modulus, which excludes flat surfaces. The logarithmic spacing loss is unavoidable uniformly under the maintained marginal-density and geometric-mixing assumptions; the iid rate remains available only under stricter design structure. No sequential-overlap or other anti-clustering premise has been added. The mean-only nonidentification result concerns only the restricted mean-information map, not equivalence of full historical wealth panels.
body.honest_scope: Proved claims are causal identification conditional on event transport; the exact raw-estimator FWL identity; four positive-affinity lower-bound embeddings inside the full-design-centered subclass; the log-adjusted conditional MSE frontier; deterministic normalized-shape weight and Taylor bounds; and a full-data conditionally honest interval with the matching expected-length frontier. The original-class replication obstruction remains valid. Higher-smoothness donor saturation follows through \(\kappa=\min\{\lambda,1\}\), conditional on the two-sided modulus. No claim is made for growing cohort count, growing proxy-path dimension, smoothness adaptation, sharp constants, or removal of the uniform mixing logarithm without stricter design structure.
body.interpretation: Full-design centering repairs the replication obstruction but does not create iid calendar spacing. More replicated units reduce event and unit-history fluctuations, and more donors reduce generated-center uncertainty; neither creates additional calendar locations near the realized path. Under the maintained geometric-mixing class, nearby locations can arrive in rare blocks, so the uniform spacing scale is \(\{\log(T\vee2)/T\}^{1/d}\).
